changelog:
Vanguard v1.0.17

- The app is now called Vanguard (UI, window titles, and the updater are all rebranded).
- Overlay module badges now update the instant you toggle a module, instead of lagging up to about a quarter second behind.
- Added a single-instance safeguard: launching while the app is already running now brings the existing window forward instead of starting a second copy, which could show a duplicate/ghost overlay in a different accent color.
- No changes to gameplay logic, keybinds, or swaps.
